title: Delivery Claims Schedule: Service Supplement for Missed Guaranteed Services
content:
Under Delivery Claims, the late-delivery make-good on a Late Delivery Claim carries a supplement for the guaranteed delivery service that was missed.

**Schedule.** The service supplement depends on the guaranteed delivery service that was missed: Same-Day Courier adds 10.00 USD, Next Business Day adds 5.00 USD, and Expedited 2-Day adds nothing.

| Missed delivery service (as shown on the order) | Supplement |
|---|---|
| Same-Day Courier | 10.00 USD |
| Next Business Day | 5.00 USD |
| Expedited 2-Day | none |

No other delivery service adds a supplement.

*Hypothetical:* two late orders, one sent by Same-Day Courier and one by Expedited 2-Day, otherwise alike: the first adds 10.00 USD to its make-good and the second adds nothing.
